thread:
matt: heads-up — I ran the funcall holdout suite against starlit-int8 on the small holdout (funcall-holdout-2026-02). baseline (fp16) pass rate 98.6%, starlit-int8 is at 93.2% so we have a regression to dig into.

sara: ouch. where are the failures concentrated? structured or nonjson suffixes?

matt: ~70% strict-schema rejects (missing keys / trailing commas), ~20% non-JSON suffixes, ~10% valid-json but wrong types (string vs array).

jia: can you paste an example?

matt: example from canary: 

```json
{"action": "create_issue", "params": {"title": "Signup error",}, "confidence": 0.92}
```

note trailing comma after "title" — fp16 rarely produced this.

sara: smells like tokenizer/quant rounding inserting an extra token before closing brace. streaming outputs worse?

matt: yes — streaming has ~3x trailing-comma rate for this model. non-streaming still slightly up vs fp16.

omar: what about KV prefix cache? holdout has a long system prefix, right?

matt: yes ~240-token prefix. rerun with prefix_cache disabled: trailing-comma failures dropped ~40%.

jia: good lead. propose A/B canary: A) prefix_cache=on + retry.max_attempts=2 (stream=true) ; B) prefix_cache=off + retry.max_attempts=1 (stream=false). measure schema_pass per 1k calls and median latency.

sara: also add a cheap client-side parser-rescue: 1) strip trailing commas, 2) ndjson-split fallback, 3) wrap-in-array if top-level missing. log when repair changes action.

matt: I'll spin two canaries in staging for 5k calls each. quick runner script (toy): 

```bash
for cfg in A B; do
  curl -s -X POST "https://staging.redwood.dev/v1/generate"
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGE_TOKEN"
    -H "Content-Type: application/json"
    -d '{"model":"starlit-int8","input":"$PROMPT","stream":'$( [ "$cfg" = A ] && echo true || echo false )',"prefix_cache":'$( [ "$cfg" = A ] && echo true || echo false )',"retry":{"max_attempts":'$( [ "$cfg" = A ] && echo 2 || echo 1 )'}}'
    >> results_$cfg.jsonl
  sleep 0.05
done
```

omar: add eval step to compute: schema_pass_rate, posthoc_repair_rate, repaired_consistency_rate, median_latency, token_entropy_on_failures.

matt: runner will output that. expected: fp16 schema_pass=0.986, starlit-int8(A)=~0.932, (B) maybe ~0.956 if prefix_cache off helps.

jia: include token-entropy diagnostic on failing samples — quant can flatten probs and raise weird tokens.

sara: if entropy is higher on fails, justify retry or soft-schema with suggested corrections.

eval-bot: scheduled run rw-canary-3270. artifacts ETA ~40m, will post here.

matt: will attach raw samples + small PR for client heuristic. if B wins without latency hit, we can ship model-tagged prefix_cache:false as temporary mitigation.

omar: don't change global defaults — use model metadata + routing override to avoid surprising dedicated customers.

sara: +1. add onboarding checklist entry to block if schema_pass delta >= 1%.

jia: added to checklist. will run stats and triage after artifacts.

matt: pinging when rw-canary-3270 finishes. :thumbsup:
